prompt:
Portrait 390×844 mobile web app screen for「台灣停車預測」, shown edge to edge with no browser or device frame. The user is a driver on the way to「新莊體育館」who wants to inspect nearby parking choices before arrival. Render the real product screen with its name, map navigation, destination search, location and filter controls, street map, selected-space panel, nearby comparison rows and bottom navigation.
The map is at close street scale. Show one short block with six individually numbered, individually tappable roadside spaces at the curb, enough separation to tap each marker; include a destination marker and one visually distinct off-street garage. Do not fill the whole map with spots. Select「正中路 25 號」and show「目前觀測：有位」「距離 180 公尺」「資料品質：可用」「一般汽車適用性：已確認」「官方觀測時間：未提供」「系統取得：10:28」「收費：20 元／小時」「抵達預測：資料不足」. Include occupied and unknown spaces with visible status shapes and text as well as color. The next rows should compare a nearby roadside space and the separate garage. Add「合成示意資料，非即時資訊」.
The visual identity translates Taiwanese roadside parking guidance into a clear digital map: warm ivory, deep navy sign lettering, green for available, red for occupied, amber for unknown, restrained enamel-like flat plates and strong white space. Keep map, search, controls and labels conventional, readable and responsive. The parking sign language is one signature accent, not a literal road sign. No invented official source, live status claim, route, arrival time, probability or performance claim.
